lines.text: Many learners say: Please speak more slow.
We use slowly to say how you speak.
The second! Please speak more slowly.

data.why: We use slowly to say how you speak.

native.tip: Em português, “devagar” não muda; em inglês, depois de speak, use slowly, com ly.
native.caption: Você também diz isso? “Please speak more slow.” 😅 O certo é “Please speak more slowly.” Em português, “devagar” não muda, mas em inglês usamos slowly, com ly. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “slowly”. Agora diga em voz alta “Please speak more slowly.” e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: In Portuguese, “devagar” does not change; in English, after speak, use slowly, with ly.
en.caption: Do you say this too? “Please speak more slow.” 😅 The right way is “Please speak more slowly.” In Portuguese, “devagar” does not change, but in English we use slowly, with ly. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
